summary.text: Gabriel Bradshaw is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Mike Vinton.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he named public transportation, Medicaid and property tax affordability as key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Gabriel Bradshaw graduated from Lockwood High School and has worked in public relations.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a fifth-generation Montanan who was born in Billings and moved with his family to Lockwood, and said his first and only job so far was five years at a local McDonald's.

Bradshaw said in the survey that he would vote to protect and expand Medicaid and would oppose raising property taxes, and that residents of the district deserve a public transportation system that works for everyone.
